scope: Existing-source inventory and fixed development discovery cohort; no selection by realized gain.
partition_rule: Primary discovery dates are strictly after static feed version date 2023-10-24. Earlier dates remain retrospective coverage only; all partitions are development data.

source_rules.endpoint_join: Service date, operator, train number, BPUIC, event type and scheduled minute; static trip/stop-sequence ambiguity retained.
source_rules.actual_status: Only REAL is a realized time. CANCELED, PROGNOSE, ambiguity and missing stay distinct.
source_rules.additional_runs: ZUSATZFAHRT_TF=true remains excluded under the original identity contract.
source_rules.source_priority: Complete daily-member filtered sources replace prefixes where present; Oct25 combines existing city and rail subsets without choosing among conflicting outcomes.

static_time_contract: Fixed historical-validity snapshot; not evidence of the snapshot published before Oct24.
message_time_contract: Raw GTFS-RT archives are local; actual labels are never publication receipts. Message availability must be established from archive capture and feed/header/update times separately.

remote.payload_accounting: Retained JSON responses only; SSH overhead and an earlier directory preview excluded.
remote.operation: Read existing directories and audit JSON; no new provider download or remote scientific run.

sources.completeness_evidence: Existing full-member range and 2,226,994 scanned rows in audit; filter_actuals_remote.py default has no prefix limit. Combined with the rail subset; exact endpoint conflicts stay ambiguous.

limitations: Coverage describes the fixed query region and time window, not the full network.
Oct21 has no actual source in the known local/server cache and remains an all-missing scheduled date.
Most available days are selected rows from a 1 MiB compressed archive prefix; missing is not cancellation.
Every date is development discovery data; historical confirmation filenames confer no new holdout status.
